tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: The published catalogue with live prices and which payment methods each plan accepts. Prices are never hardcoded; read them here.

tools.name: order_lease
tools.description: Place an order. The trial plan is free and activates immediately; paid plans return payment details and stay pending until settled. No account or card is needed to order. A second trial for the same billing email is refused — order a paid plan instead, which needs no approval.

tools.name: lease_status
tools.description: Everything about one lease: whether it is active, which addresses it holds, its tunnels and when it renews.
